title: Open-OmniCoach: Evidence-Enhanced Trajectory Learning for Omni Video Agents
title_zh: Open-OmniCoach：面向全模态视频智能体的证据增强轨迹学习
abstract_en: Training capable omni video agents requires more than diverse question-answer pairs: agents must learn to reliably find, connect, and correct task-relevant evidence in omni-setting. However, we argue that existing data pipelines provide limited control over task-relevant evidence and weak supervision for these capabilities. In this work, we present Open OmniCoach, a new framework for evidence-seeking omni video agents. It contains a high-quality dataset, OmniCoach-240K, and a new agentic reinforcement learning (RL) method, Step-Level Evidence-Guided Policy Optimization (SEPO). For the former, OmniCoach-240K comprises 248.2K interaction trajectories, including 230.7K multi-span trajectories and 17.4K reflection trajectories. We design a three-stage data pipeline by leveraging both fine-grained omni-evidence and the agent's own errors. Meanwhile, compared with other RL baselines, SEPO provides turn-level credit based on improvements in evidence coverage and temporal localization. Applying both trajectory data and the SEPO method, we obtain Open OmniAgent models. The resulting models outperform the baselines across multiple video and audio-visual understanding tasks by significant margins, demonstrating the effectiveness of the Open OmniCoach framework. In particular, Open OmniAgent-30B improves average accuracy over Qwen3-Omni by 6.3 percentage points across nine benchmarks, with gains of 12.2 and 13.3 points on LVOmniBench and LVBench, respectively.
abstract_zh: 仅靠多样化的问答对，难以训练出能够可靠查找、串联任务相关证据并纠正取证错误的全模态视频智能体。现有数据构建流程对任务相关证据的控制有限，也缺乏对这些能力的直接监督。为此，Open-OmniCoach 提出数据集 OmniCoach-240K 和强化学习方法 Step-Level Evidence-Guided Policy Optimization（SEPO）。OmniCoach-240K 通过三阶段流程，利用细粒度全模态证据与智能体自身的错误，构建了约 24.82 万条交互轨迹，其中包括约 23.07 万条跨时间片段轨迹和 1.74 万条反思轨迹。SEPO 根据证据覆盖度和时间定位的改善，为每轮交互分配学习信号。结合轨迹数据与 SEPO 训练的 Open OmniAgent 在多项视频和音视频理解任务上优于基线。其中，Open OmniAgent-30B 在九项基准上的平均准确率较 Qwen3-Omni 提升 6.3 个百分点，在 LVOmniBench 和 LVBench 上分别提升 12.2 和 13.3 个百分点。
key_points_zh: 训练目标不只是答对问题，还包括找到并串联跨时间片段的证据，以及纠正取证错误。
OmniCoach-240K 包含约 24.82 万条交互轨迹，利用细粒度证据和智能体自身的错误构建跨时间片段轨迹与反思轨迹。
SEPO 按轮衡量证据覆盖度与时间定位的改善，为各轮交互分配学习信号。
Open OmniAgent-30B 相较 Qwen3-Omni 在九项基准上的平均准确率提升 6.3 个百分点，在 LVOmniBench 和 LVBench 上分别提升 12.2 和 13.3 个百分点。

agent-multimodal.reason: 核心贡献是用音视频交互轨迹和证据反馈更新视频智能体策略。相较于其他强化学习基线，SEPO 按证据覆盖率和时间定位的改善分配逐轮信用，提供了可操作的奖励设计。九项基准的量化结果支持整体框架，但未单独验证 SEPO 的贡献。
